label: W Prime Extension
description: W Prime Extension for Hammerhead Karoo that calculates anaerobic energy balance in real-time during rides.
releaseNotes: Improved W′ field readability: larger regular-weight numbers, a 25% smaller battery icon, safe vertical margins, stable sizing for 1-4 characters in full-width fields and better use of half-width space with the trend arrow beside the header. Visual layout verified on Karoo 3.
